segments.text: Regular whiteboards were cool until the electrostatic whiteboard showed up. Here are five reasons people
are making the switch to the electrostatic whiteboard. One, it doesn't need any tape or
drilling to set up. Seriously, it uses an electrostatic charge to stick onto your walls,
meaning all you have to do is just place it where you want, and that's it.
Two, you can make it any size you want. Maybe you have a lot of space and you
want it across your entire wall. Maybe your spot is a little tighter
and want your whiteboard on a thin strip of your wall. Maybe you want it on your desk.
Whatever size you want, simply cut it to the length of the area you want to put it in,
and boom, you've got a whiteboard there. 3. It leaves no damage on your walls ever.
This uses the power of science to stick to your walls, whereas regular whiteboards need
super strong stickers, or even worse, drilling holes into your walls.
4. You get so much value for your money. The most common whiteboard size used in homes
are around 4 feet in length and can cost anywhere between $50 to $100. This one costs less than that
and is more than double the size and length, not to mention the fact that they include free markers
and cloths in every order. Right now, they've got Bundle Deal offers live and they're ending soon.
